sources.title: XLM-R: Multilingual Transformer Model
sources.snippet: XLM-R is a multilingual Transformer-based model that leverages masked language modeling across 100 languages for robust cross-lingual transfer. It is trained on over 2 TB of data with a large vocabulary size, enabling effective processing of both high-resource and low-resource languages.
